label: Default
description: Default button. Best for the main call to action with no variant or size prop, the base the other examples change.

label: Secondary
description: Secondary button. Best for a lower emphasis action on the secondary fill, for the alternative beside a primary one.

label: Outline
description: Outline button. Best for a bordered action that ranks below the filled styles, for neutral choices next to them.

label: Ghost
description: Ghost button. Best for a borderless action with no fill until press, for toolbars and dense rows of controls.

label: Destructive
description: Destructive button. Best for an action in a soft destructive tint with destructive text, for delete, remove or revoke.

label: Link
description: Link button variant. Best for an action styled as link-coloured, underlined text with no fill or border, still announced as a button.

label: Extra Small
description: Extra small button. Best for the smallest size of the scale, for tags and chips in dense rows; its touch area still reaches 44 pt.

label: Small
description: Small button. Best for the text size one step below default, for compact forms, card footers and toolbars.

label: Large
description: Large button. Best for the tallest text size of the scale, for a hero or a single main call to action on a screen.

label: Disabled
description: Disabled button. Best for an action that cannot run yet: it takes the disabled fill, blocks presses and is announced as disabled.

label: Icon Button
description: Icon button. Best for a square icon-only search control at the default 44 pt size, named for screen readers by its label.

label: Icon Right
description: Button with an icon on the right. Best for a primary Get Started call to action with a static trailing arrow after the label.

label: Loading State
description: Button in a loading state. Best for a fixed pending state: a spinner in place of the glyph, presses blocked, announced as busy.

label: Icon Left
description: Button with an icon on the left. Best for a primary Download action led by a cloud download icon before its label.

label: Invalid State
description: Button with an invalid state highlight. Best for a submit tied to a form that failed validation: the destructive border marks it.

label: Secondary Icon Left
description: Secondary button with an icon on the left. Best for a secondary-fill action led by a glyph before its label.

label: Secondary Icon Right
description: Secondary button with an icon on the right. Best for a secondary Open Project action with a trailing external link icon after its label.

label: Outline Icon Left
description: Outline button with an icon on the left. Best for an outline Add Item action led by a plus sign, for creating a new record in a list.

label: Outline Icon Right
description: Outline button with an icon on the right. Best for an outline Options control ending in an adjustments icon, for opening settings or filters.

label: Ghost Icon Left
description: Ghost button with an icon on the left. Best for a ghost Settings entry led by a gear, for sidebars and account menus.

label: Ghost Icon Right
description: Ghost button with an icon on the right. Best for a ghost Logout action with a trailing sign out arrow, for the end of an account menu.

label: Destructive Icon Left
description: Destructive button with an icon on the left. Best for a destructive Delete Account action led by a trash can icon.

label: Destructive Icon Right
description: Destructive button with an icon on the right. Best for a destructive Confirm Removal action ending in a warning circle, for the last step of a delete.

label: Extra Small Icon
description: Extra small icon button. Best for the smallest square size as an outlined close X on a chip, a tag or a toast; its touch area still reaches 44 pt.

label: Small Icon
description: Small icon button. Best for a small borderless bell for a notifications entry in a dense top bar.

label: Large Icon
description: Large (lg) icon-only button. Best for the largest square size on the primary fill with a play icon, for a media start control.

label: Next Link
description: Button that navigates. Best for moving to another screen with the primary look: the press calls the router, as a link would.

label: Link Icon Left
description: Link button with an icon on the left. Best for a link-styled Help center entry led by a question mark circle.

label: Link Icon Right
description: Link button with an icon on the right. Best for a link-styled View documentation action with a trailing up-right arrow.

label: Large Icon Left
description: Large button with an icon on the left. Best for a large Upgrade Now call to action led by a lightning bolt, for plan upsells.

label: Large Icon Right
description: Large button with an icon on the right. Best for a large Send Message action with a trailing paper plane, as at the foot of a contact form.

label: Outline Invalid
description: Outline button with an invalid state. Best for an outline control beside a failed field: its border turns destructive.

label: Ghost Invalid
description: Ghost button with an invalid state. Best for a ghost control in an invalid form, which gains a destructive border it otherwise lacks.

label: Email Login
description: Button with an icon on the left. Best for a primary Login with Email action led by an envelope, for an email first sign in form.

label: More Less Toggle
description: Ghost button with a more / less toggle. Best for a ghost Show more control whose label and chevron flip between more and less on each tap.

label: Outline Social Icons
description: Icon-only share targets. Best for a wrapping row of 6 outlined icon buttons, each named for screen readers by its target.

label: Like Count
description: Like button with a count. Best for a filled Like action with a thumbs up and a 456 count split off by a thin divider, read out as one.

label: Star Count
description: Star button with count. Best for an outline Star action with a muted 589 count after a border colored divider.

label: Unread Badge
description: Button with an unread badge. Best for an outline Inbox entry with a destructive count badge pinned over its top right corner.

label: Shortcut Keys
description: Button with a shortcut. Best for an outline Search launcher with the Command K keys inside it, for phones and tablets with a keyboard.

label: Copy Feedback
description: Copy button with feedback. Best for an outline Copy action with a visible label that turns to Copied with a check for 1.5 seconds.

label: Icon Copy
description: Icon-only copy button with feedback. Best for a square copy control that confirms with a check, its tooltip shown on press and hold.

label: Hamburger Toggle
description: Menu / close toggle button. Best for a square menu control whose glyph swaps to an X and back, its name following the state.

label: Async Action
description: Async action button with loading and success states. Best for a Save changes action that runs idle, saving and saved, then resets after 2 seconds.

label: Inline Count
description: Outline button with inline count badge. Best for an outline Messages entry with an outlined count badge sitting inline after the label.

label: Status Dot
description: Button with a status dot. Best for an outline Live label with a pulsing green dot at its right edge (still under Reduce Motion).

label: Status Badge
description: Ghost button with a status badge. Best for a filled Updates entry with a small success colored New tag after the label.

label: Notification Badge
description: Icon button with a notification badge. Best for a square bell with a destructive count badge pinned over its corner, the count in its name.

label: Go Back
description: Go back link button. Best for a Go back action in the link style with a leading chevron, going back in the stack.

label: Animated Go Back
description: Go back with a moving chevron. Best for the Go back link whose chevron nudges left while it is pressed.

label: Expanding Button
description: Expanding button from icon to label. Best for a round plus that widens to show Create new when tapped, like a floating action control.

label: Title & Description
description: Multi-line button with icon, title & description. Best for a tall left aligned choice with an icon tile, a Credit Card title and a muted line of help text.

label: Sliding Arrow
description: Pill call to action. Best for a round Get started with a trailing arrow, for an onboarding screen's single call to action.

label: Shortcut Tooltip
description: Shortcut tooltip button. Best for a square search control whose press-and-hold tooltip names it and shows the Command K keys.

label: Avatar
description: Button with avatar. Best for a filled account chip pairing a small avatar with a handle, at the default height.

label: Outline Avatar
description: Outline button with avatar. Best for an outline account chip with a small avatar and handle on the page background.

label: Small Avatar
description: Small button with avatar. Best for the filled avatar chip at the small size, for tight headers and comment rows.

label: Small Outline Avatar
description: Small outline button with avatar. Best for the outline avatar chip at the small height, for dense lists of people.

label: Social Login Stack
description: Sign-in method stack. Best for a stacked column of 4 outline sign-in choices, each led by a tone-coloured glyph.

label: Colored Social Icons
description: Icon-only sign-in methods. Best for a row of 4 equal-width icon buttons in category tones, each named for screen readers.

label: Theme Toggle
description: Theme toggle button. Best for a square sun and moon swap that switches the app between light and dark, named by the next mode.
